Contract EnterValidatedCreditReferencesModule::markRequestValid(): Boolean {
	definition:
		CurrentLoanRequest: LoanRequest,
		CurrentLoanRequests: Set(LoanRequest)
	precondition:
		CurrentLoanRequest.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		CurrentLoanRequests->includes(CurrentLoanRequest) and
		CurrentLoanRequest.Status = SUBMITTED
	postcondition:
		let req: LoanRequest = CurrentLoanRequest in
		req.Status = REFERENCESVALIDATED and
		result = true
}
